about: iPhone WebXR through Variant Launch's App Clip (src/web/launch.ts). Empty key = off. Caleb's project "ORI Falls Park" (free Developer tier), authorised for raw.githack.com. Their snippet adds &redirect=true; we leave it off and show our own button instead. The key is publishable (it goes in a public script tag) and bound to the hosting domain in Launch's dashboard. ?vlkey= on the URL overrides it.
